Tally Prime → PostgreSQL → Dashboard → Claude AI Tally Intelligence Platform Proposal

Objective

Enable management and finance teams to access real-time business insights from Tally using a centralized PostgreSQL database, operational dashboard, and Claude AI-powered natural language queries.

Phase 1: Data Foundation & Dashboard (Week 1)

Tally → PostgreSQL Integration • Enable Tally XML/ODBC access • Deploy PostgreSQL database • Build python automated data sync from Tally to PostgreSQL • Create core tables for Receipt, Payment, Journal, Purchase, Sales, Contra, Sales Order, Stock Journal, Stock Item, Outstanding, Ledgers, P&L, Customers and Vendors Management Dashboard • Develop a web-based dashboard connected to PostgreSQL • Display core tables and overview of changes • Requirements: Supplier-side Tally Prime Web API access, VPS, Cloudflare account Deliverable • Live dashboard with near real-time data from Tally

Phase 2: Claude AI Integration (Week 2)

MCP Server Deployment • Deploy MCP server connected to PostgreSQL • Configure secure access between Claude AI and PostgreSQL • Enable natural-language querying Demonstration Queries • Show all overdue receivables • Which customers owe more than ₹5 lakh? • What is today's cash position? • Show top 10 debtors • Summarize sales for the last quarter • Provide GST summary for the current month Deliverable • AI-powered finance assistant

Phase 3: Advanced Analytics & Intelligence (Week 3)

Receivables aging analysis • Cash-flow monitoring • Profitability analysis • Ledger reconciliation • Inventory movement analysis • GST compliance reporting Deliverable • Advanced financial intelligence and decision-support capabilities

Phase 4: Production Readiness (Week 4)

User authentication and role-based access • Query logging and audit trails • Automated database backups • Sync monitoring and alerts • System documentation and user training Deliverable • Production-ready Tally Analytics & AI platform

Final Deliverable

A centralized Tally intelligence platform consisting of: Tally Prime → PostgreSQL → Management Dashboard → Claude AI The solution provides real-time visibility, automated reporting, and AI-driven business insights while eliminating manual Excel-based analysis and report preparation.
